integrity: All equations are proved in RESULT.md; verify.py independently tests finite prime-field cases. The finite tests are corroboration, not an infinite proof. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple undirected graphs and their standard free-edge two-step Lie brackets over finite fields only; no identification of all Lie-subalgebra types, orbit classification, or algorithmic polynomial-time guarantee. The maximal dimension was previously known; the assessed claim is the complete dimension distribution. Literature priority is provisional.
title: Exact abelian-subalgebra enumerators of finite graphical Lie algebras
